description: This file defines the ReactAgentController class in Dart for a Flutter application. It manages the state and interactions for a React Agent screen, including API key handling, starting/stopping the agent, and providing UI-related data such as icons and colors for different step types.

classes.name: ReactAgentController
classes.description: A controller class that manages the state and behavior of the React Agent screen, including API key management, agent operation, and UI element data.

methods.name: loadStoredApiKeyAndConfigure
methods.description: Loads a stored OpenAI API key from secure storage and configures the agent service accordingly.

methods.name: saveApiKey
methods.description: Saves the provided API key to secure storage and updates the agent service, returning a status message.

methods.name: clearApiKey
methods.description: Clears the stored API key and switches the agent to mock mode.

methods.name: startAgent
methods.description: Starts the agent with the current user input, ensuring input validation.

methods.name: clearSteps
methods.description: Resets the agent state, clearing steps, error messages, and user input.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon for a given step type.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Returns the appropriate color for a given step type.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Returns the string title for a given step type.
